_doc: placecheck grounding rules. Units: metres and degrees. Sign convention everywhere: gap = object bottom minus support surface,
so gap > 0 floats and gap < 0 is sunk. Tune values here; a change invalidates the check cache for that category only.
contact_lods: which LOD gives the contact geometry, first one present wins (landcontact 2e15, visual = first resolution LOD,
geometry 1e13, roadway 3e15). band: contact points are the vertices/edge samples within this height of the object's lowest
point (band_frac: fraction of the model height, the larger of the two wins). max_samples caps the points tested per object.
support: 'terrain' or 'terrain_or_host' (a host building's Roadway LOD, or its Geometry LOD when it has no Roadway).

plant.desc: tree, bush, bamboo, grass: the base must dip into the soil all round (every bottom point >= min_sink under it); terrain at the stem may rise above the model's ground line (MLOD origin) by <= max_embed. The base rim = the lowest point in each of `sectors` directions around the centre of the model's bottom `band`, within base_radius of it (so a slanted trunk cut is followed all round and drooping leaf cards further out are ignored)

rock.desc: rock or boulder: its lowest part must be embedded all round

building.desc: building, wall, pad: footprint gap <= gap_tol everywhere; terrain may rise above the model's ground line (MLOD origin) by <= embed_max

prop.desc: small prop: bottom within +-tol of its support (terrain, or a host building's floor)

hanging.desc: hanging prop (lantern, sign): every attach point within tol of a host's Geometry LOD

road.desc: road piece: its Roadway surface follows the terrain. mode drape = the engine drapes class=road pieces per vertex, so only terrain bumps between vertices count; rigid = the piece as placed

skip.desc: not checked (water surfaces, markers, invisible helpers)

size_fallback._doc: no naming match: largest extent below prop_max_size = prop, else building. A 'building' match that small also becomes a prop

overrides._doc: class name or p3d path (lower case, backslashes) -> category. Wins over everything else.
